name: Notion Custom Agents
desc: Autonomous agents in Notion that run on triggers or schedules.
desc_zh: 在 Notion 里按触发条件或排程自动干活的智能体
solves: Recurring questions and triage eat the same hours every week. A Custom Agent answers, routes and reports on its own schedule.
solves_zh: 重复的提问和任务分流每周吃掉同样的时间。自定义智能体按排程自己回答、分流和写汇报。
best_for: Your IT channel gets the same onboarding questions every Monday and nobody wants to answer them again.
best_for_zh: IT 群每周一都收到同样的入职问题，没人想再回答一遍。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.notion.com/releases/page/5）。 Different from the ledger's Notion Agent (2025-09), which is the on-demand personal agent: Custom Agents are shared, scheduled agents with their own permissions. A Custom Agent directory and admin controls followed on 2026-05-05 and 2026-05-06. The help article is used as the homepage because the release post links to help pages and templates, not a dedicated product page. No media source was read. 评审修正（2026-11-25）：官方名字「Custom Agents」在卡片上认不出属于谁。 首次公开日期来源：https://www.notion.com/releases/2026-02-24
